key_decisions.rationale: Preserves woman’s name, ancient amount, value, material, embodied devotion, and sensory effect.
key_decisions.before: Mary took a pound of expensive perfume made from pure nard, anointed Jesus’ feet, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
key_decisions.after: Then Mary took a litra of expensive perfume made from pure nard, anointed Jesus’ feet, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the perfume’s fragrance.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then Mary, taking a pound of costly perfume of pure nard, anointed the feet of Jesus and wiped his feet with her hair, and the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps narrator’s motive, theft, entrusted funds, and embezzlement sense.
key_decisions.before: He said this not because he cared about the poor but because he was a thief. He kept the moneybag and used to take what was put into it.
key_decisions.after: He said this not because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief. He kept the common money box and stole what was put into it.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But he said this not because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, he used to take what was put into it.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves solemn agricultural image, death, aloneness, and fruitfulness.
key_decisions.before: Truly, truly, I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the ground and dies, it remains alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
key_decisions.after: Truly, truly, I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the ground and dies, it remains alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Truly, truly, I say to you, unless a grain of wheat falling into the earth dies, it remains alone; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps stark love-hate contrast, this world, keeping, and eternal life.
key_decisions.before: Whoever loves their life loses it, and whoever hates their life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
key_decisions.after: Whoever loves their life loses it, but whoever hates their life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The one loving his life loses it, and the one hating his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps real distress, prayer possibility, hour, and accepted purpose.
key_decisions.before: “Now my life is troubled. And what should I say? ‘Father, save me from this hour’? But this is why I came to this hour.
key_decisions.after: “Now my soul is troubled. What should I say—‘Father, save me from this hour’? But this is the very reason I came to this hour.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now my soul has been troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this hour’? But for this reason I came to this hour.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps repeated now, judgment, ruler, and expulsion.
key_decisions.before: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the ruler of this world will be cast out.
key_decisions.after: Now is the judgment of this world; now the ruler of this world will be driven out.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now is the judgment of this world; now the ruler of this world will be cast out.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves conditional exaltation/crucifixion and universal drawing.
key_decisions.before: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to myself.”
key_decisions.after: And when I am lifted up from the earth, I will draw everyone to myself.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all to myself.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves fulfillment, Isaiah, report, arm image, and revelation.
key_decisions.before: so that the word spoken by Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled: “Lord, who has trusted our message? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
key_decisions.after: This fulfilled the word of the prophet Isaiah: “Lord, who has believed our report? And to whom has the Lord’s arm been revealed?”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he said: “Lord, who has believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves divine-agent wording, sensory-heart sequence, turning, and healing without resolving responsibility.

key_decisions.after: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their heart, so that they might not see with their eyes, understand with their heart, turn, and I would heal them.”
